svg.title: Benchmark research
svg.desc: Benchmark: MiniWoB++ through BrowserGym, What it measures: Over 100 locally hosted web interaction tasks; deterministic rewards. BrowserGym's standard configuration has 125 task types, five repeats and ten actions., Decision for this machine: Run all 625 episodes per browser arm.; Benchmark: WebArena, What it measures: 812 tasks on self-hosted replicas of full websites; functional evaluators., Decision for this machine: Not run: required site containers are absent and the local Docker daemon is unavailable.; Benchmark: Online-Mind2Web, What it measures: Tasks on real websites, judged from actions and screenshots., Decision for this machine: Not run: this repository permits localhost-only tests; dataset access and model judging are additional dependencies.; Benchmark: WebdriverIO's browser tool comparison, What it measures: Playwright MCP/CLI, WebdriverIO, Stagehand and agent-browser under a shared model and harness. Its current suite samples Online-Mind2Web., Decision for this machine: Inspected methodology; not executed for the same live-site/dataset/judge restrictions.
